verdict.rationale: Temporal ships an official CLI, documented at docs.temporal.io/cli. It installs via `brew install temporal` and covers managing, monitoring, and debugging applications (`temporal workflow list`, `temporal operator namespace list`), running a local dev server (`temporal server start-dev`), and a Cloud extension for control-plane administration. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable JSON output for agents), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
